name: helm_roof
description: Helm roof (盔顶/Rhenish helm): square tower roof with FOUR gable ends. Wiki recipe ground-truthed: stairs face only TWO directions (filled square layers, north rows face south, south rows face north), each layer inset 1 on all sides (every face shows a triangle = four gables), and the middle row(s) are slabs plugging the seam ('slabs under the main roof blocks'). Odd width comes to a point; even width gets a 2-row seam. Base-course seam uses double slabs so nothing floats.
when_to_use: Square towers, church spires, castle corner turrets. origin = the tower footprint's north-west corner, y = first layer ABOVE the top wall block. Prefer odd widths (the wiki: helms work better on odd-width towers). DIRECTION STATES ARE DERIVED BY THE SCRIPT — never hand-edit facing/half/shape (禁止手改方向状态).
use_for: 方形塔楼/教堂塔尖/城堡角楼收顶;奇数宽塔(5/7/9)效果最佳

origin.notes: 塔 footprint 西北角;y = 墙顶上一层

width.notes: 方塔宽;奇数收尖(推荐),偶数中缝两条

ridge_material.notes: 中缝半砖(底层自动 type=double 封基)

spire_material.notes: 塔尖材料(fence/wall 类);空=无尖

spire_height.notes: 尖顶层数;仅奇数总宽(单尖点)可用

pitfalls: 楼梯只朝两个方向(南北两排)——四向楼梯的盔顶'very fiddly'且效果差(wiki),别改输出里的 facing
奇数宽才收尖;偶数宽中缝是两条且不能加 spire(报错会提示),要尖塔就把塔宽改成奇数
中缝半砖是堵缝关键(底层 type=double 坐墙线,上层 type=top 层层相叠)——换整砖会高出半格,删掉留通天缝
四角 outer 转角、脊端 inner 转角都由脚本按邻接推导;四个三角形山墙面是几何自然结果,不用另做山墙
盔顶是塔楼收顶,不是大屋顶方案:宽>13 的方体请考虑 hip/mansard
example: python patterns/helm_roof.py --params '{"origin":[100,83,100],"width":7}' --out helm.json && python patterns/helm_roof.py --params '{"origin":[100,83,120],"width":7,"spire_material":"minecraft:spruce_fence","spire_height":2}' --out helm2.json
